:new: New project intention · #34 Formalizing Masures associated to Kac-Moody groups

The goal is to formalize the axiomatic of the "masures" introduced by Gaussent and Rousseau in

Stéphane Gaussent and Guy Rousseau, Kac-Moody groups, hovels and Littelmann
paths, Annales de l’institut Fourier, vol. 58, 2008, pp. 2605–2657

that are generalizations of Bruhat-Tits buildings adapted to the study of Kac--Moody groups over valued fields. We plan to follow Hebert's axiomatisation proposed in

Auguste Hebert. A new axiomatics for masures II. Advances in Geometry, 2022, 22 (4), pp.513-522.
